title: Canonical completed restriction comparisons are unital and associative
statement: Fix the prime l, coefficient extension E, scheme X, finite-field datum D, and l unequal to D.p as in [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower]. Let C_n be the canonical derived restriction from finite coefficients to completed coefficients, U_n the finite identity restriction comparison, A_{r,m,n} the canonical comparison of two finite restrictions, and G_{m,n}: Res_{m,n} ⋙ C_m ≅ C_n the canonical completed restriction comparison specified in that definition. For every P in the finite derived category at n, G_{n,n}(P)=C_n(U_n(P)). For every n≤m≤r, C_r(A_{r,m,n}^{-1}(P)) followed by G_{r,m}(Res_{m,n} P) and G_{m,n}(P) equals G_{r,n}(P). These are equalities of the specified canonical maps, including repeated indices.

source.place: Strict representative construction of the Roos model: compatibility of completed restriction with identity and composite quotient maps. Ordinary equality checked sectionwise; derived equality uses Stacks derived.tex lemma-right-derived-exact-functor and categories.tex lemma-properties-left-localization.

proof.text: Ordinary restriction comparisons act as the identity on every underlying section. By substituting the equalities of coefficient maps, the unit comparison is the whiskered identity-restriction comparison, and the square for three restrictions commutes. This applies to the projection from the completed coefficient sheaf as well as to finite quotients.

Pass the ordinary unit and associativity squares through exact derived restriction. The mapDerivedCategory composition compositor and lifted natural-isomorphism comparisons satisfy the same squares, by cancellation of their localization factorization isomorphisms. The proved MapDerivedCategoryMate unit law and MapDerivedCategoryCocycle associativity law implement these cancellations. Cancel the finite compositor to put associativity in the displayed inverse-comparison form. All identities hold for arbitrary derived objects by uniqueness of localized natural transformations.

lean.statement:
theorem normalizedDVR_completedRestriction_coherence
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{t}) (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{d}) (hl : l ≠ D.p) :
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (P : normalizedDVRDerived l E X n),
      (normalizedDVRResCompletedComp l E X D hl (Nat.le_refl n)).hom.app P =
        (normalizedDVRResCompleted l E X D hl n).map
          ((normalizedDVRResUnit l E X n).hom.app P)) ∧
    (∀ {r m n : ℕ} (hrm : m ≤ r) (hmn : n ≤ m)
      (P : normalizedDVRDerived l E X n),
      (normalizedDVRResCompleted l E X D hl r).map
          ((normalizedDVRResComp l E X hrm hmn).inv.app P) ≫
        (normalizedDVRResCompletedComp l E X D hl hrm).hom.app
          ((normalizedDVRRes l E X hmn).obj P) ≫
        (normalizedDVRResCompletedComp l E X D hl hmn).hom.app P =
      (normalizedDVRResCompletedComp l E X D hl (hmn.trans hrm)).hom.app P)
